name: CFEval
intro: CFEval 是 Qwen3-VL 技术报告中与 LiveCodeBench v6、OJBench 并列的代码评测。公开报告仅给出数值分数，未披露任务来源、规模、执行协议、评估器或评分公式，也未找到独立的 CFEval 论文或公开数据集。
eval_feature: 仅公开报告表格中的原始分数；任务与评分协议未披露
drawio_review_note: Evidence-bounded to arXiv:2511.21631, the Qwen3-VL technical report. The public report classifies CFEval as a coding benchmark and presents raw numeric model results beside LiveCodeBench v6 and OJBench. No standalone CFEval paper, official dataset, task count, source description, language, split policy, prompt/execution contract, evaluator, correctness rubric, score unit, or aggregation formula was identified in the public source review. The diagram therefore marks each of those elements as not disclosed and shows only the minimal supported sequence from reported benchmark identity to model output, undisclosed evaluator, raw score, and table comparison; it intentionally makes no Codeforces or rating inference.
eval_feature_en: Only Raw Scores in a Public Report Table; Task and Scoring Protocol Not Disclosed
intro_en: CFEval is a coding benchmark listed in the Qwen3-VL technical report beside LiveCodeBench v6 and OJBench. The public report provides numeric scores but does not disclose the task source, scale, execution protocol, evaluator, or score formula, and no standalone CFEval paper or public dataset was identified.
